value.rationale: J(6,3) is the smallest self-complementary middle-layer Johnson graph beyond the triangular-graph cases, naturally singled out in the 2023 classification of unstable Johnson graphs. Its nine-regular open-neighborhood complex is outside prior low-valency classifications. The explicit integral 2-torsion and complete Moore-space homotopy type distinguish it from rationally equivalent sphere bouquets and from the published Johnson Rips/clique sphere-wedge theorem. This is a precise natural invariant for a canonical symmetric graph, with potential use in graph-Hom comparisons and topological graph coloring; it is not a random parameter slice or known-table recomputation.
